programs.name: 100km Trail Ultra Program - Undulating
programs.description: One hundred undulating kilometres is a full day and often a night, and this 20-week program builds you for it methodically. Aerobic volume, back-to-back long runs, power hiking and durable downhill legs are developed in sequence, with fuelling, kit and crew plans tested in training. Pacing is taught as a discipline, because the early hours decide the late ones. Hard weeks and recovery weeks are timed to your hormonal rhythms rather than set arbitrarily. You'll arrive genuinely prepared.
